<thought>We have the mass spectrum showing a molecular ion at m/z 268.19, likely [M+H]⁺, giving a neutral monoisotopic mass of ~267.19 Da. To identify the structure with minimal additional experiments, the next most informative low‑cost data is the ¹H NMR spectrum, which can reveal the number and type of hydrogen environments and help narrow down the possible molecular formula and functional groups. I will request the proton NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>Requesting ¹H NMR data to proceed with structure elucidation.</final_answer>
